target_customer: Funded startups and SMBs with idle cash after a fundraise
problem: Founders park cash at money market rates and face finance decisions they are not equipped for. Palus invests cash in a higher yield bond portfolio and advises as a fiduciary.
business_model: Advisory and treasury management fees via an SEC registered adviser subsidiary; site also sells fractional CFO services
product_category: Startup treasury management and financial advisory

founders.name: Sam Lushtak
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built an AI research platform for an asset manager with over $3T AUM and managed cash for Fortune 500 companies.

founders.name: Michael Gonzalez
founders.background_notes: YC page says he wrote monitoring software for defense contractors operating quantum computer fleets, claimed to save $150M.

competitors.name: Mercury Treasury
competitors.what: Treasury product inside a startup bank

competitors.name: Rho Treasury
competitors.what: Startup banking with treasury sweep up to $75M
competitors.traction_then: up to 3.71% APY cited in 2026 guides

competitors.name: Brex Treasury
competitors.what: Spend management with treasury returns of 3.35 to 3.70%

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly integrations with banks, Plaid and payment rails plus portfolio construction; the hard part is regulation, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Registered adviser status and fiduciary duty distinguish it from banks, but banks can launch treasury products and the service is easy to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Startup banks already offered treasury yield; none were found offering fiduciary advice. No action against Palus found.

market_need_then: Startup banks compete on yield, with multiple 2026 guides comparing treasury rates, which shows founders care about idle cash yield.

identity.mascot_or_character: Palus Bot shown in Slack demo
identity.visual_style: Finance site with a Slack bot demo

branding.brand_signature: Palus Bot in Slack with 24/7 access
branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Hacker News on 2026-03-06 as Launch HN.

brand_strength.rationale: A Hacker News launch gave some exposure, but no press about the brand itself was found.

pivots.from: Treasury yield platform and startup financial advisor per YC page and launch
pivots.to: Fractional CFO firm with treasury per current company site
pivots.why: Not stated; the site and Dakota listing now describe fractional CFO, advisory and treasury services. Date approximate, the site fetch did not give one.

outcome_analysis: Palus is a Winter 2026 company with two Caltech founders, a Hacker News launch and a May 2026 Modern Treasury payments announcement. Its site has broadened to a fractional CFO firm claiming 60 plus clients, which suggests a pivot toward services. No exit or layoff reports found, so the outcome is open and no factors are assigned.
notes: Caplight, Standout and CB Insights list a $500K pre-seed or convertible note with YC; these aggregators only, unverified, so not recorded as a round. CB Insights wrongly describes it as a blockchain stablecoin project. Company site reports 60 plus businesses served, self reported, and names no founders. The pivot entry rests on differences between the YC page and the current site.
